While the original contract was compliant, this addition confirms both parties understand federal tax regulations for bond-financed facilities.
Revenue Definition Updated to ensure IRS safe harbor compliance requirements.
Safe harbor requirements for revenue -based incentives prohibit compensation based on net profits (revenues minus expenses).
Incentive compensation must tie to quality, performance, or productivity metrics.
While the original contract was compliant, this addition confirms both parties understand federal tax regulations for bond-financed facilities.

Service Scope Clarification The renewal formalizes service updates made via Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) since the last renewal, including the provision of concession services by OVG and a requirement to follow the University’s catering policy.
Compensation – Incentive Tier Restructuring Upon request from the University, OVG restructured the Ryan Center incentive tiers to reduce their earnings following increased alcohol sales revenue (beer/wine sales approved January 2022).
Event Marketing Fund Oak View Group will contribute an additional $150,000 to an existing event marketing fund, that was initially stood up with a $250,000 contribution at the first 5-year renewal.
